name: 1001sovet.ru real-service certification
principles: A test earns PASS only after a response from the named live service is validated.
Mocks, fixtures, local emulators, dry-runs, and simulated provider callbacks never count toward certification.
A missing credential, test identity, provider sandbox, callback, or cleanup proof is BLOCKED, not skipped or passed.
The default runner is read-only. State-changing tests require a dedicated owned QA resource and an explicit run approval.
requiredActiveProof: email-password registration, confirmation, login, reload persistence, logout, reset, and QA-account cleanup
VK and Yandex login with separate owned provider accounts, callback, reload persistence, logout, and identity replay
subscription double opt-in through a dedicated inbox, category selection, delivery, management, unsubscribe, and database cleanup
browser push permission, subscribe/unsubscribe HTTP responses, a real sandbox fan-out, receipt, and subscription cleanup
contact, question, comment, rating, reaction, save, collection, user article, photo upload, moderation, and exact cleanup using a dedicated QA identity
admin article edit/publish/unpublish/version/rollback with optimistic-conflict and idempotency cases; renderer/cache/sitemap/search propagation; exact restoration
R2 object upload, public retrieval, metadata verification, purge propagation, and version/object cleanup
Telegram, MAX, WhatsApp, Resend, VK, Facebook, and social-responder real provider callbacks and outbound delivery against private owned QA channels only
cron/digest/autopost execution with correlation IDs, provider-side receipts, duplicate prevention, and cleanup
analytics delivery verified in the live provider dashboards from an unblocked independent network
